title: Volcanoes of Iceland (hard)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Iceland, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: Grimsvotn
rounds.fact: Grimsvotn is a caldera; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1996. The data places it in Iceland.

rounds.name: Thordarhyrna
